# Primary-source review snapshots

Exact public response bodies support the corpus's reviewed identity annotations.
The corpus records their URLs, observation times, SHA-256 digests, byte lengths
and short excerpts. The evaluator verifies those bindings without network access;
it does not interpret HTML or turn a reviewer assertion into a production edge.

Do not edit source bodies or replace them in place. New observations require new
paths and updated corpus identities. These snapshots are research evidence, not
a general SEC, registry or corporate-website ingestion adapter.
